title: Stylish 2BR on Music Row w/ Pool & Downtown Views
description:
Located in the heart of one of Nashville’s most vibrant and sought-after streets, this spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit seamlessly blends comfort, style, and convenience. Just minutes from the city’s top bars, acclaimed restaurants, and coffee shops. Enjoy premium amenities, including a stylish resident lounge with a pool table, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and an outdoor patio. The building also features a luxurious Baja-style pool, and a trendy outdoor bar.

The space
Enjoy your time in The Music City with your group of friends or family by spreading out in our spacious new-construction condo.  This home is the perfect place to get ready for your night out on Broadway, or to relax as a group while using our ample open-space social area and fully equipped kitchen. Wind down your day in our generous sleeping arrangements or cozy up on the couch to watch your favorite show.

Other features:
Pool
Rooftop common areas
Billiards table in building
Underground parking garage
Bar cart with shakers and glassware
Drip coffee maker and k-pod machine
Washer and dryer 
Excellent wireless internet
Streaming television
Extra pillows and blankets
Comfortable linens
Cotton bath towels
And much more!

Guest access
Keyless entry to the property via keypad. The details for the the keypad code will be sent to you 24 hours before your check-in time.

Other things to note
This condo is located in the heart of beautiful music city row it has gated underground parking and security staff on duty 24/7.
